about: cc-P146: hand-written, checked in. tools/decisions.py reads every notes file's decisions section; this file says which older prompts are only noted (notAsked: their deviations were never put to Chase as questions, and stay out of the default view), gives the wording, options and default where the parse is not enough, splits prose sections by hand (entries with a prompt and a section), records answers given elsewhere (status elsewhere, with answer and source) and moot ones (status moot, with reason), and names the play-test items each prompt's decisions replace on the page. A prompt not listed in notAsked is asked: from P146 on, a new prompt's decisions are open questions with nobody editing this file. The importer never writes it.
